name: Eleanor Vance
bio:
Eleanor Vance's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on her family's farm in rural Iowa. This practical upbringing instilled in her a deep understanding of mechanical systems and a passion for problem-solving. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she started her career in aerospace, but the roar of the racetrack beckoned. She transitioned to motorsport, drawn to the high-pressure environment and the constant push for innovation.

At RFK Racing, Eleanor is known for her methodical approach and ability to see the big picture. She excels at identifying key areas for improvement and implementing data-driven solutions. Her focus is on maximizing the car's performance through a combination of rigorous testing, detailed analysis, and close collaboration with the drivers and other engineers. Eleanor's ability to balance technical expertise with effective team management makes her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, usually pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor is of average height with a focused and intelligent expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized toolbox.
